title: Newly concluded apprenticeship contracts (Germany)
description: Number of newly concluded training contracts (neu abgeschlossene Ausbildungsverträge) in dual vocational training in Germany during the calendar year, by sex and training area.
source_label: Destatis GENESIS 21211-0004: Newly concluded training contracts
comparability: National series from the Berufsbildungsstatistik (statistic 21211; reported by the competent bodies — chambers etc. — to the statistical offices). Covers dual vocational training under the Vocational Training Act (BBiG) and the Crafts Code (HwO) only; school-based VET (e.g. health and care schools, Berufsfachschulen) is not included. Flow: contracts concluded between 1 January and 31 December and still recorded by the competent body (Destatis count). BIBB's figure for new contracts (survey at 30 September, see de-bibb) uses a different reference period and is not identical. Do not add to other countries' figures.

provenance.citation: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), GENESIS-Online, table 21211-0004 (Berufsbildungsstatistik). Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung – Version 2.0.
